semantics: Recovery adds only five explicit old-profile width aliases to 35 handwritten testbench profiles. DUT, stimuli, expected values and frozen references are unchanged. Eight initial system passes retain their original source provenance; only the affected benches/components are rerun.

environment.effective_workers: Component targets/profiles sequential; existing phase3 runners use at most two compiler workers. Variant systems may run in a separate serial batch on disjoint build directories.

source_scope: Derived delivery index, not a rewrite of the historical capture: all retained source hashes rechecked; unused stage5 files and entrypoint-only removals listed explicitly; original full reports copied byte-for-byte.
limitations: Finite two-state differential regression. Floating-point system uses frozen HDL and independent arithmetic checks, without Python snapshot replay. Component structural checks and this simulation are not cell area/frequency measurements.
